t: Faithfull jerry can spout is designed for efficient and accurate liquid transfer from jerry cans. Robust metal construction, featuring carbon steel, ensures durability for trade professionals and DIYers. The spout clips neatly onto the can top, forming a tight, leak-free seal for secure pouring. A flexible nitrile rubber tip prevents damage to receiving containers, while the rubber seal ensures a water-tight connection. The green spout allows for precise pouring of contents, reducing waste and making it ideal for refuelling machinery or vehicles on site.
